panel.title: Metric points count
panel.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, count() AS points
FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
